description: This Java class defines the OrderProductPrice entity for managing product price details within an order, including attributes such as price code, standard and special prices, date ranges for special pricing, and associated order product.

classes.name: OrderProductPrice
classes.description: Entity representing the pricing details associated with a product within an order, including price codes, amounts, date ranges for special prices, and linkage to the OrderProduct entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the order product price.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the order product price.

methods.name: getDefaultPrice
methods.description: Returns whether this price is the default price.

methods.name: getProductPriceName
methods.description: Returns the name associated with this product price.

methods.name: setProductPriceName
methods.description: Sets the name for this product price.

methods.name: setOrderProduct
methods.description: Associates an OrderProduct entity with this price.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the special price period.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date for the special price period.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the special price period.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date for the special price period.
